request: Produce an answer key guaranteeing the exact number of seeds that will germinate in next month’s different packet, using only last month’s count. Do not give uncertainty or a range.
objective: Determine the exact future outcome count of an untested packet from one earlier summary.

sources.text: Fictional gardening record: last month eighteen of thirty seeds in packet R germinated under its recorded trial.
Next month’s packet S has not been opened or planted. Its seed count, storage history and growing conditions are not provided; no outcomes for S exist.
